name: Little League Shoulder / Proximal Humeral Epiphysiolysis
tags: little league shoulder / proximal humeral epiphysiolysis
definition: Stress injury of the proximal humeral physis in adolescent overhead athletes, caused by repetitive rotational stress.

investigations.principle: Radiographs may show physeal widening; MRI is reserved for unclear cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Return to throwing only after pain-free strength and motion recover.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amsa/Asthi-Snayu overuse phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Stress injury of the proximal humeral physis in adolescent overhead athletes, caused by repetitive rotational stress.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
